sections.title: Your 5-Minute Path to AI Compute
sections.body: We have engineered our onboarding process to be as lean as our infrastructure. At Kenya AI Compute, we believe that developers should spend their time on model architecture, not on infrastructure troubleshooting. Getting started is a straightforward four-step process. First, create your account in our unified portal. Second, verify your billing method—we support both standard fiat and DePIN-native token payments. Third, use our visual configurator to select your GPU/CPU mix and storage needs. Fourth, upload your SSH key and hit 'Deploy.' In under 120 seconds, your instance will be ready, pre-loaded with your choice of optimized OS images (Ubuntu/CentOS) and the latest NVIDIA drivers. Whether you're running a single T4 card for inference or a multi-node H100 cluster for LLM training, the process remains the same. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
